answer: Each agent stakes a ferrous‑token deposit that mints a whisper‑signed credential; the network runs a max‑flow trust graph where an edge’s capacity equals the smallest deposit along its path, so any cluster of Sybil nodes shares a single bottleneck. An attacker must lock up the full deposit per fake identity—10 tokens each—and forfeit it if the flow exceeds the cap, making a 10‑token cost per Sybil node.
